title: Bile
summary: BILE, noun [Latin bilis.] A yellow bitter liquor, separated from the blood in the liver, collected in the pori biliarii and gall bladder, and thence discharged by the common duct into the duodenum. BI

inlines.v: BILE, noun [Latin bilis.] A yellow bitter liquor, separated from the blood in the liver, collected in the pori biliarii and gall bladder, and thence discharged by the common duct into the duodenum. BILE, noun An inflamed tumor. [See Boil, the correct orthography.]
